subject: Security intake: SOC2 Type II report + trust portal access
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Heather Tang <heather.tang@trustconnector.com>, Audrey Lin <audrey.lin@trustconnector.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — security intake

Hi Heather / Audrey — thanks again for the quick call this morning. Recap + proposed next steps below so we have a shared plan.

Call recap (high-level)
- TrustConnector evaluating Redwood for document summarization + search in a customer-facing product.
- Primary blockers: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter (for auditor procurement), and VSQ responses.
- Regulatory scope: they need confirmation around GDPR applicability and potential HIPAA controls for a pilot with healthcare customers.

Next steps (what I’ll do)
1) Provide our latest SOC 2 Type II summary and the full report or a secure way to access it via our trust portal.
2) Draft a bridge letter for your procurement/audit team to confirm scope & exception windows.
3) Share a VSQ template you can start filling (or send your questionnaire and we’ll map answers).
4) Confirm timeline: I can get portal access set up and core docs over within ~3 business days once you confirm the legal contact.

Action for you
- Please confirm the primary legal/procurement contact (name + email) for DocuSign/bridge-letter routing.
- Confirm whether the evaluation will involve EU production data (GDPR concern) or PHI (HIPAA).

Attachments: compliance-intake-form.xlsx (quick intake to speed info gathering)

Happy to jump on another 15-min follow-up if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: compliance-intake-form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Heather Tang <heather.tang@trustconnector.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — security intake

Thanks Ben — that plan works. Quick answers and asks from our side: 

- Legal/procurement contact: Audrey Lin (audrey.lin@trustconnector.com). She’ll own the bridge letter and contract redlines.
- GDPR/HIPAA: this pilot will likely process EU user content for a small subset and may touch PHI for one pilot customer, so we need to be explicit about both GDPR and HIPAA controls/BAA applicability.
- Can you confirm whether your SOC 2 Type II covers data processing for customer-facing SaaS (production) and indicate the reporting period for the last Type II? Our auditor will ask.

We’d prefer to start with your VSQ template — I’ll have our security lead begin it and follow up with questions. Also please include any sample bridge-letter wording you typically use.

Thanks — Heather
Heather Tang
Director, Procurement | TrustConnector
heather.tang@trustconnector.com | +1 (206) 555-0114

> Thanks Ben — that plan works. Quick answers and asks from our side: 
> - Legal/procurement contact: Audrey Lin (audrey.lin@trustconnector.com).
> - GDPR/HIPAA: this pilot will likely process EU user content for a small subset and may touch PHI for one pilot customer, so we need to be explicit about both GDPR and HIPAA controls/BAA applicability.
> - Can you confirm whether your SOC 2 Type II covers data processing for customer-facing SaaS (production) and indicate the reporting period for the last Type II?

Thanks — and all good — looping in Karthik from security to handle technical scope and bridge letter drafting. Quick answers below and timeline: 

- SOC 2 Type II: Our most recent Type II report covers our hosted inference platform and operations for the period 2026-09-01 to 2027-02-28 and explicitly includes production SaaS data processing (controls around access, logging, incident response, encryption at rest/in transit). I’ll provide the summary pdf and route secure access to the full report via our trust portal.
- Bridge letter: Karthik will prepare a draft; typical turnaround 2 business days.
- VSQ: attaching our VSQ template (vsq-template.xlsx). Feel free to send your questionnaire if you prefer — we’ll map answers.
- Portal access: I can provision a TrustConnector read-only view and an auditor role for your auditor contact; expect the invite within 3 business days after you confirm the legal contact (Audrey).

Attachments: vsq-template.xlsx, redwood-soc2-typeii-summary.pdf

Next steps: 
1) Audrey — confirm final emails for portal + auditor.
2) Karthik — I’ll defer to you for bridge letter and any follow-up technical Qs.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Heather Tang <heather.tang@trustconnector.com>, Audrey Lin <audrey.lin@trustconnector.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — security intake

Hi Heather / Audrey — Karthik here (security). I’ll take point on the bridge letter and the VSQ mapping. A couple of clarifying items to make sure the draft and portal package match your auditor expectations: 

1) Reporting period confirmation: Ben’s summary is correct — Type II period 2026-09-01 to 2027-02-28. We can provide the full report via the portal to your auditor once we have the auditor email.
2) Scope questions: please confirm whether the pilot will include EU production data at rest in your cluster or whether data will be routed to Redwood-hosted EU region. If you expect data residency in the EU we’ll note that in the bridge letter and include relevant controls; otherwise we’ll confirm the controls that apply to US-hosted production.
3) PHI/HIPAA: if PHI is in scope for the pilot please confirm which customer(s) and the data flow (ingest -> inference -> retention). That will determine the BAA conversation — we can provide standard BAA language but may need legal to sign.

I’ll attach a short bridge-letter draft for your procurement team to review (bridge-letter-draft.docx) and start mapping VSQ answers internally once I get the VSQ back. Expected internal turnaround for a first-pass VSQ mapping: 3 business days.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
[Attachment: bridge-letter-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
